lines.en: Each region now has a leaderboard.
It's a quiz on whether apartment names are real.
lines.findEn: real or fake by name alone

lines.ko: 같은 지역 문제를 푼 사람끼리 겨룹니다.
lines.en: Players of the same region compete together.
lines.art: a small winners' podium standing on top of a map of a single province

lines.en: Your spot shows up like 137th of 240.
lines.art: a giant arrow pointing at one person standing in a long line of people

lines.en: Names have their middle letter hidden.
lines.art: a blank name tag with a strip of tape covering its middle

lines.en: But switching regions wiped out your score.

lines.ko: 그래서 지역마다 점수를 따로 쌓게 했습니다.
lines.en: So now each region keeps its own score.
Boards open once a region has 10 players.
lines.art: a door that swings open as a crowd of small figures gathers in front of it

lines.en: Until then, only I can open them while I polish.
It's no longer a game you play alone.

failCard.beforeEn: Scores went only to the last region picked
